verdict.rationale: Salv's documented API lets an external system update alert status and create or update manual alerts, so alert-level decisions can be pushed in. Webhooks notify a client application about events such as new alerts or risk-level changes, so changes can be pulled out programmatically. However, nothing documents API or webhook access to cases themselves (notes, documents, assignee, case status), so syncing investigations is unevidenced. Missing for 10: case/investigation read-write API endpoints, case-level webhook events, documented two-way sync with an external case-management system, independent corroboration.
